about_the_game:
Embark on a legendary journey where 100+ goddesses from different races await your command!

Welcome to a world where strategy, collection, and creativity define your journey.

🎙️ Renowned Voice Acting

Top Japanese voice actors, including Nana Inoue and Kana Yuki, bring every goddess to life. Enjoy personalized voice lines and dynamic Live2D animations for a truly immersive experience.

📖 Deep Storylines

Follow the epic main story and uncover each goddess’s personal journey. Unlock invitation and trial stories to explore their pasts and the lore of this world.

⚔️ Master Tactical Battles

Engage in 6v6 battles on a strategic 2×3 grid:

• Position your goddesses carefully to protect allies and defeat enemies.

• Combine skills and abilities to unleash powerful team bonuses.

• Execute spectacular special moves with stunning visual effects.

💎 Player-First Economy

Transparent gacha system with high SSR rates.

Regular events let you earn powerful characters for free, alongside generous rewards.

All story content and PvP modes are fully accessible without spending — victory comes from smart strategy, not heavy spending.

🌐 Play Anywhere

Full cross-platform support lets you sync progress between PC and mobile seamlessly, so you can continue your adventure anywhere.

✨ Community & Global Reach

Join over 5 million players worldwide and experience strategic 6v6 battles with dynamic goddesses.

Our community is diverse and welcoming, with players from every corner of the world.

Developer’s Letter

Dear Commanders,

Welcome to Goddess of Fate, a project born from our team’s love for strategic RPGs and heartfelt storytelling.

From the very beginning, our goal has been simple: to create a world where tactical depth meets emotional connection. Every goddess you encounter was crafted with care—designed, animated, and voiced to feel truly alive. We’re honored to have partnered with talented Japanese voice actors such as Nana Inoue and Kana Yuki, whose performances breathe soul into each character, sometimes fierce, sometimes gentle, but always full of heart.

Combat in Goddess of Fate rewards smart strategy over raw power. Victory isn’t about having the rarest cards; it’s about how you use them—mastering formations, exploiting synergies, and seizing the right moment to strike.

Most importantly, we wanted to create a game that respects your time.

All main content, including the full story, is fully playable without spending a single cent. Optional purchases exist only for those who wish to enhance their experience, never to gate progress. Your success depends on your strategy, creativity, and perseverance, not on spending.

We’re deeply grateful to have you with us on this journey.

We can’t wait to see the teams you build, the tactics you master, and the stories you’ll share along the way.

Thank you for playing, and welcome to the world of Goddess of Fate.

The Goddess of Fate Team ✨

The idea for Goddess of Fate was born from our team’s shared love for anime, mythology, and strategic gaming. We were inspired by the rich tapestry of global mythologies, where gods and goddesses embody the essence of human emotions, aspirations, and conflicts.

From the fiery determination of a war goddess to the serene wisdom of a celestial deity, we wanted to bring these archetypes to life as unique, relatable characters—waifus with depth, personality, and stories that resonate. Our vision was clear: create a game that celebrates the diversity of these goddesses while offering players a chance to form meaningful connections with them through gameplay and narrative.

Anime has always been a medium that transcends borders, blending stunning visuals with compelling storytelling. We wanted Goddess of Fate to capture that magic, combining the charm of anime-style characters with the strategic depth of card-based RPGs. But we didn’t stop there. We sought to push boundaries by integrating dynamic Live2D visuals, a robust affinity system, and a tactical combat framework that rewards creativity and planning. Our mission was to craft an experience that feels alive, where every goddess is more than a card—she’s a companion on your legendary journey.

Crafting the Goddesses: Art, Voice, and Soul

At the heart of Goddess of Fate are its 100+ goddesses, each a unique blend of mythology and anime flair. From the outset, we knew that the characters would be the soul of the game. Our art team worked tirelessly to bring these goddesses to life using Live2D technology, which allows for fluid, dynamic animations that make every character feel vibrant and responsive. Whether it’s the flutter of a goddess’s hair in the wind or the subtle shift in her expression during a heartfelt moment, these details create a sense of intimacy and immersion. For special goddesses, we introduced interactive touch reaction skins, allowing players to engage with their favorite characters in a playful, personalized way.

Sound design was equally critical. We partnered with renowned Japanese voice actors, including talents like 井ノ上奈々 and 優木かな, to give each goddess a distinct voice that reflects her personality. From the commanding tone of a warrior goddess to the soft, teasing lilt of a mischievous spirit, every line was recorded to enhance the emotional depth of the characters. The voice library, unlocked through our dating-sim-style affinity system, lets players discover new dialogue as they build relationships with their goddesses. This system isn’t just a feature—it’s a way to make every interaction feel personal, as if these characters are truly growing alongside you.

A World of Stories: Epic and Intimate

The narrative of Goddess of Fate is designed to be both grand and personal. The main storyline follows your journey as a summoner tasked with uniting the goddesses to restore balance to a fractured world. This epic tale is filled with twists, betrayals, and moments of triumph, drawing inspiration from classic anime tropes and mythological sagas. But what sets our story apart is its depth and variety. Beyond the main plot, each goddess has her own “invitation story,” a personal narrative that delves into her origins, dreams, and struggles. These stories are unlocked through gameplay and affinity progression, offering players a chance to connect with their favorite characters on a deeper level.

Additionally, we introduced “trial stories” that challenge players to uncover hidden lore and earn exclusive rewards. These bite-sized narratives add layers to the game’s universe, revealing the interconnected fates of the goddesses and the world they inhabit. Whether it’s a tale of a celestial goddess’s sacrifice or a mischievous fox spirit’s redemption, these stories are crafted to evoke emotion and spark curiosity. Our writers worked closely with cultural consultants to ensure that the mythological inspirations—spanning Eastern and Western traditions—are respectful and authentic, while still infused with the playful energy of anime storytelling.

Tactical Combat: Strategy Meets Spectacle

Combat in Goddess of Fate is where strategy and spectacle collide. Our 6v6 tactical battle system is built around a 2×3 grid, where positioning is as critical as team composition. Placing a goddess in the front row might maximize her offensive potential but expose her to greater risk, while a back-row placement could enhance her support abilities but limit her impact. This system demands careful planning, as every decision—from unit placement to skill selection—can turn the tide of battle.

To deepen the strategic experience, we designed a robust synergy system that rewards creative team-building. Mixing and matching goddesses from different races—such as celestial, demonic, or elemental—unlocks exclusive team effects that enhance performance. For example, pairing a fire goddess with a wind spirit might trigger a “Blazing Tempest” synergy, boosting attack speed and critical damage. These synergies encourage experimentation, ensuring that no two players’ squads feel the same. Add to this our dynamic skill combos and flashy special effects, and every battle becomes a visual and tactical feast.

Player-First Philosophy: Accessibility and Fairness

One of our core principles is ensuring that Goddess of Fate is welcoming to all players, regardless of whether they choose to spend money. We’ve designed a player-first economy that prioritizes accessibility and fairness. Our gacha system is transparent, with high SSR rates and guaranteed banners to give players a fair shot at their favorite goddesses. In-game events offer ample opportunities to earn free base characters, making it easy for collectors to build their dream roster without breaking the bank. Most importantly, there are no paywalls—every piece of story content and PvP reward is fully accessible to free-to-play players.

This approach has resonated with our community, as evidenced by our 92% 7-day retention rate, far surpassing the industry average of 62%. We’re also proud to have a 25% female player base, the highest in the strategic card game genre, reflecting our commitment to creating a game that appeals to a diverse audience.These numbers aren’t just stats—they’re a testament to the trust and enthusiasm our players have shown us, and we’re dedicated to maintaining that trust through ongoing updates and fair practices.

A Global Experience: Cross-Platform and Localization

We designed Goddess of Fate to be a truly global game. With seamless cross-platform support, players can sync their progress between mobile and PC, enjoying buttery-smooth gameplay at up to 140 FPS on desktop. This flexibility ensures that whether you’re on the go or at home, your journey with the goddesses is always within reach. Our localization team worked diligently to create a Western-friendly UI and design, ensuring that cultural nuances are preserved while making the game accessible to players worldwide. From intuitive menus to clear tutorials, we’ve strived to make Goddess of Fate a welcoming experience for both seasoned anime fans and newcomers.

Our Commitment: Building a Community with You

Creating Goddess of Fate has been a labor of love, but we know that a game’s true potential is realized through its community. We’re committed to listening to your feedback, whether it’s about balancing combat, adding new goddesses, or refining story content. Our roadmap includes regular updates with fresh characters, events, and story arcs, ensuring that the game evolves alongside our players. We’ve already seen the incredible creativity of our community, from fan art of the goddesses to strategic guides shared on social platforms like X. Your passion inspires us, and we can’t wait to see how you shape this world.

We also want to foster an inclusive community where players of all backgrounds feel valued. Whether you’re a collector chasing every goddess, a tactician dominating PvP, or a story enthusiast diving into the lore, Goddess of Fate is your game. Join our official community channels to share your strategies, favorite moments, or even suggestions for new goddesses—we’re all ears!

Looking Ahead: A Legendary Journey Continues

As we look to the future, we’re excited to expand the world of Goddess of Fate. New goddesses, cross-over events, and deeper storylines are already in the works, alongside quality-of-life improvements based on player feedback. We’re exploring ways to enhance the affinity system, perhaps by adding new interaction mechanics or exclusive rewards for maxed-out relationships. We’re also considering seasonal PvP leagues and global tournaments to give competitive players a chance to shine.

Final Words: Your Adventure Awaits

Goddess of Fate: Waifus RPG is more than a game—it’s a celebration of anime, mythology, and the bonds that unite us. With 100+ goddesses, dynamic Live2D visuals, tactical combat, and a player-first economy, we’ve crafted a world where every player can find their place. Whether you’re drawn to the strategic depth, the emotional stories, or the sheer joy of collecting waifus, we hope Goddess of Fate becomes a journey you cherish.

Thank you for joining us on this legendary adventure. Let’s summon the goddesses, forge unbreakable bonds, and write a saga that echoes across the ages!
